text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aaargh! So close! Just a little bit more!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"The positioning, the mind games over 
pace... It was a heated race and so much 
fun, but..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, that just makes it 
all the more frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Ehehe, thank you. Yeah, I gave it my 
absolute all, and I even managed to place.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm greedy, so I want to take first 
place.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So, to make sure I win next time, please 
give me more and more training! No matter 
how tough it is, I'll execute it 
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna use today's frustration as 
motivation for my training!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'll work even harder and win next time! 
Let's join forces and do our best, 
Trainer!"
